Nepal Teacher Saves 1,600 Students from Devastating Flood

A teacher in Nepal successfully evacuated over 1,600 schoolchildren moments before their school was inundated by devastating floods. The incident occurred last week during severe flooding that impacted the region. The teacher's swift action is credited with saving all the students from the disaster.
